You can shop for antique, vintage, and facsimile Bibles through online marketplaces like [eBay](https://www.ebay.com/b/1st-Edition-Christianity-Bibles-Antiquarian-Collectible-Books/29223/bn_7377661) and [Etsy](https://www.etsy.com/market/bibles_old_unique_rare) , as well as local listings on [Facebook Marketplace](https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/107863029237016/search/?query=old+bibles).[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/107863029237016/search/?query=old+bibles)[[2]](https://www.ebay.com/b/1st-Edition-Christianity-Bibles-Antiquarian-Collectible-Books/29223/bn_7377661)[[3]](https://www.etsy.com/market/bibles_old_unique_rare)

#### Where to Buy

- **Antique & Collectible Marketplaces:** Browse [eBay](https://www.ebay.com/b/Christianity-Bibles-Original-Antiquarian-Collectible-Books/29223/bn_55469451) for 19th-century family Bibles, leather-bound editions, and individual antique Bible leaves. Note that many listings labeled "1611" or "1560" at lower prices are modern facsimiles or single pages rather than complete originals.[[1]](https://www.ebay.com/b/1st-Edition-Christianity-Bibles-Antiquarian-Collectible-Books/29223/bn_7377661)[[2]](https://www.ebay.com/b/Christianity-Bibles-Original-Antiquarian-Collectible-Books/29223/bn_55469451)[[3]](https://www.ebay.com/b/Christianity-Bibles-Antiquarian-Collectible-Books/29223/bn_55465582)[[4]](https://www.etsy.com/market/old_authentic_bibles)
- **Vintage & Heirloom Shops:** Check [Etsy](https://www.etsy.com/market/old_authentic_bibles) for mid-century family Bibles, vintage study editions, and facsimile reprints.[[1]](https://www.etsy.com/market/old_authentic_bibles)[[2]](https://www.etsy.com/market/bibles_old_unique_rare)
- **Local Pickup:** Search [Facebook Marketplace](https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/107863029237016/search/?query=old+bibles) to inspect binding condition, page wear, and genealogy entries in person before buying.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/107863029237016/search/?query=old+bibles)

#### What to Check Before Buying

- **Original vs. Facsimile or Leaf:** Confirm whether a listing is a complete antique book, a modern reprint/facsimile, or a single leaf ("page") from an older printing.[[1]](https://www.ebay.com/b/1st-Edition-Christianity-Bibles-Antiquarian-Collectible-Books/29223/bn_7377661)[[2]](https://www.etsy.com/market/old_authentic_bibles)
- **Publication Date & Edition:** According to [Biblio](https://www.biblio.com/book-collecting/basics/is-my-family-bible-valuable/?srsltid=AYCX9vK9Wtttfd-jFdF7AfYN4JodbmLdjP00PifjH3aoil-Q0m3WBzxq) , higher collectible value generally applies to pre-1700 European Bibles (especially in English) and pre-1850 American Bibles. [Britannic Auctions](https://www.britannicauctions.com/blog/is-my-old-bible-worth-money/) notes that post-1800 Bibles are typically modest in value unless tied to notable provenance.[[1]](https://www.biblio.com/book-collecting/basics/is-my-family-bible-valuable/?srsltid=AYCX9vK9Wtttfd-jFdF7AfYN4JodbmLdjP00PifjH3aoil-Q0m3WBzxq)[[2]](https://www.britannicauctions.com/blog/is-my-old-bible-worth-money/)
- **Condition:** Check for detached boards, spine damage, foxing (age spots), water stains, and missing pages.
